rationale: The event only changes help visibility; all content is already rendered and no other behavior consumes the assign.
The preview event fetches data scoped to the current owner before showing it.
The panel template and App.Panels.open implementation are missing.
After step two is visible, the name exists only in assigns. A remount clears it; recovery sends only the email and cannot reconstruct the name or step.
The stable form ID and phx-change recover both rendered inputs through the validate callback; save uses submitted fields.
The rendered form and App.Wizard restoration/update paths are missing.
Freshly queried Post structs have unloaded authors; card/1 causes an association query for each post.
The list preload batches authors. The later per-item preload sees the association already loaded and does not reload it.
The helper implementations are missing, so their database behavior cannot be established.
